# Praxis Automation

Controlled source snapshot of openhands-automation 1.19.3, maintained within Praxis
for this first infrastructure migration. Scheduling, webhooks and dispatch remain
in this component; execution belongs to Praxis SDK.

Start through the Praxis launcher. It supplies the local Agent Server address,
API key, persistence and Praxis SDK requirements. No hosted App-API URL is supplied
by default. MIT copyright and license are retained in LICENSE.
